name: Don't Go Into the Dollhouse
source:
Brooklyn loves horror—except for the real-life kind. Like the disappearance of their childhood best friend, who was never seen again. Now a blogger twenty years later, Brooklyn posts an "advice" column for surviving horror situations. The problem arises when their missing BFF appears to be commenting on their posts... and inviting Brooklyn to come back to the Dollhouse, the same place Annah disappeared. Weird things continue to pile up until Brooklyn's life looks a lot more like a horror story than they ever imagined...

Will Brooklyn follow Annah back into the Dollhouse... or will they write a new ending to this horror story?

[From [url=https://mercsanchan.itch.io/dont-go-into-the-dollhouse]itch.io[/url]]
